name: Coarse-to-Fine Volume Maximum Search
definition: A two-stage search algorithm to find the approximate location of the maximum value in a volume along a ray. The first stage performs a coarse linear scan, and the second stage refines the position using a divide-by-two approach.
summary: Coarse-to-Fine Volume Maximum Search is a two-stage algorithm that finds the approximate maximum value in a volume along a ray by combining a global linear sweep with localized binary-search-like refinement.
